edits.old: Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails
edits.new:
Then the grant refuses the statement and the build fails

  Scenario: AC6 Business rules BR1 to BR10 (section 8)
    Given the business rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 are in force
    When the boundary and guardrail tests run
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 holds as stated in section 8

  Scenario: AC7 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a provided operation is called
    When the call presents no valid login, the role lacks the Asset and disposal right, or the case is not found
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 respectively and carries the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC8 Activity retry and timeout (X5)
    Given a case in state ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON
    When a consumed call does not answer inside 2 s during the takeOnAsset activity
    Then the step retries on the workflow schedule and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC9 Consumed call fails or its breaker is open (X5)
    Given a consumed call fails or its circuit breaker is open
    When the take-on step runs
    Then nothing is written and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC10 Disallowed status change is refused (X3)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns a case state other than ASSET_PENDING_TAKE_ON
    When the take-on is requested
    Then the answer is 409, nothing is written and the take-on is not re-evaluated
